scope: Disposable Edge context, synthetic naming responses, real offline reload; no signing or financial requests.
checks: opening the name screen performs no lookup or account creation
explicit lookup shows normalized name, exact network and unverified identity boundary without saving by default
busy state blocks duplicate submissions and input changes
saved result reopens offline without being presented as a fresh lookup
changed destination is visible and failed or mismatched responses preserve a stale-labelled prior result
changing naming network hides unrelated results and forgetting affects only the saved name
both themes reflow at desktop and narrow widths without clipping
name suffix selects NEAR and its network without opening options
missing ENS resolver shows no address instead of implying the name is unregistered
